title: 100 People Enter A Living Maze. Only 1 Gets A Wish
description: A hundred strangers, one night inside a hedge maze that hears everything, and a real wish for whoever is left at dawn. Would you last until morning? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Mira: 16-year-old girl, long chestnut hair in a single braid, olive green hooded jacket over a cream sweater, dark brown trousers, worn leather boots, small canvas backpack with a tin water bottle, no hat
characters.Teo: 75-year-old man, short white beard, thin white hair, faded blue work shirt with rolled sleeves, brown canvas apron, gray trousers, holds old iron garden shears, no hat
characters.Goro: 40-year-old man, slicked-back black hair, thin mustache, wrinkled gray suit with loose red tie, no hat

scenes.say: A hundred people walk into a living hedge maze at sunset. Whoever is still inside at dawn wins one real wish. The only warning at the gate: the maze hears everything.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Wide shot of a giant dark hedge maze on a moonlit hill, one tall iron gate glowing faintly. [4-7s] Medium shot of Mira at the iron gate of the hedge maze, gripping her backpack straps, a few people beside her. [7-10s] Close-up of the hedge walls inside the maze slowly breathing, leaves rustling though there is no wind.

scenes.say: Mira finds an old gardener trimming hedges in the dark. She shares her water with him. Nearby, a man named Goro lies about the exit, and the hedges swallow him whole.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside a narrow moonlit corridor of the hedge maze, Teo snips leaves with iron shears. [4-7s] Mira hands Teo her tin water bottle; he smiles and drinks. [7-10s] In a nearby hedge corridor, Goro points the wrong way to someone, then branches curl around him and pull him into the leaves.

scenes.say: The maze spits him out at the gate, unhurt. Thirty-seven people lie in the first hour. Sixty-three remain. At midnight, a breeze whispers to each of them: why did you come?
scenes.video: [0-4s] Outside the iron gate of the hedge maze, the hedge spits Goro onto the grass, dazed and leaf-covered. [4-7s] Inside the hedge maze under a full moon, a soft silver breeze glows as it moves down a corridor. [7-10s] Close-up of Mira listening, her braid lifting in the glowing breeze.

scenes.say: Forty-eight people give noble answers they don't mean, and the hedges fold them out. Fifteen remain. Mira tells the truth: her little brother can't breathe without a machine.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In a hedge maze corridor a man speaks proudly to the glowing breeze, and the hedge wall gently folds over him. [4-7s] Medium shot of Mira kneeling in a quiet hedge maze clearing, speaking softly to the breeze. [7-10s] Close-up of Mira's face, wet eyes, the hedge leaves around her calmly still.

scenes.say: At three in the morning, a warm fog rolls in, carrying the voices of everyone's families calling them home. Fourteen people follow the voices out. Mira covers her ears and stays.
scenes.video: [0-4s] A warm golden fog flows through the corridors of the hedge maze. [4-7s] A young man in the fog turns toward a soft voice and walks out through an opening hedge. [7-10s] Mira crouches against a hedge wall in the golden fog, hands over her ears, eyes shut.

scenes.say: At dawn, the old gardener is waiting, and every hedge bows to him. 'You were the only one who shared,' he says. A hundred walked in. One walks out with a wish.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Sunrise over the center clearing of the hedge maze, Teo stands holding his shears. [4-7s] The hedge walls around the clearing bend low toward Teo like bowing; Mira stares, stunned. [7-10s] Close-up of Teo placing her tin water bottle back in Mira's hands, a warm light glowing inside it.
